title: Archiving the parliamentary memory of the Low Countries
descriptions: This dataset contains the enriched parliamentary proceedings of the Belgian Lower House from 1848 until 1914. Please go to the README.md file (tab Data Files) for more details about the data. The easiest way to download and use the data: In the folder 'zipped data' you find the zipped versions of both Members and Proceedings. The RNC schema is online available. The Members and Proceedings files and the RNC schema are also available as separate files for durability reasons.
